blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.a: Two SD43 schools are physically located in the village: Anmore Elementary (30 Elementary Rd, Anmore) and Eagle Mountain Middle School (110 Dogwood Dr, Anmore), checked against the BC Ministry K-12 schools file used by this program. Catchment for a specific home is address-based and must be confirmed in the SD43 locator — no Anmore locator run is on record in this program (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Does Anmore have a SkyTrain station?
faq.a: No. Anmore has no SkyTrain station; the Millennium Line stations shown on TransLink's regional connections diagram nearest the village are Moody Centre and Inlet Centre, both in the neighbouring City of Port Moody.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Anmore?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Anmore is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
